name: Website Builder
tagline: Turn a business idea into a live site on your own domain
description: Describe the business and it comes back with a complete company website: page layout, written copy, images and contact forms. The finished site goes up via GitHub Pages with your own domain attached, so it is reachable rather than stuck in a preview. It stays on afterwards to keep pages current when things change.
author: Rebeldawg
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
